limits: The single most probable composition, not the whole distribution.
Labelled samples are not natural-abundance, so the answer does not apply to them.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which isotopic composition is this peptide most likely to carry, and how abundant is it?

description: The most probable isotopic composition of a peptide (e.g. how many 13C atoms it most likely carries) and that composition's relative abundance, from natural isotope abundances (validated against pyteomics).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: isotopic_composition

composition.description: element -> isotope mass number -> atom count
